lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 14 distinct vertical line segments are visible traversing the torso. Spacing is relatively uniform across the central thoracic region, with line width increasing in the mid-section and narrowing towards the anterior and posterior extremities.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped bifurcation is observed in the upper third of the 10th line (counting from the posterior) where it splits before reaching the dorsal ridge. A secondary merging of line fragments is visible in the lower quadrant of the 6th and 7th lines.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line 4 is highly discontinuous, appearing as a series of three distinct dashed segments. Multiple isolated white blobs are situated between lines 7 and 8, as well as between lines 13 and 14, representing incomplete vertical line structures.

posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: The spots on the haunch exhibit a near-vertical alignment, approximately parallel to the 1st and 2nd torso lines, forming a broken geometric extension of the stripe pattern onto the hind limb.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent white spot is visible on the lower mandible/cheek area. Large, rounded ears feature a high-contrast white fringe on the internal pinnae. A distinct white crescent or patch is visible at the base of the throat.
